'''TK-8H2''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], TK-8H2 was stationed in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], alongside [[Nial Declann]] and another stormtrooper, designated [[TK-9H4]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
TK-8H2 is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, the stormtrooper simply guards Nial Declann.
